name: Chorizo, potato & cheese omelette
assumptions: Yield estimated at 1 serving based on single omelette cooked in an omelette pan with listed ingredients scaled for one person

Total time is sum of explicit cooking steps (8-10 min potato + 2 min chorizo + 5 min potato/chorizo + omelette cooking ~5 min + 1 min final cook) rounded to nearest 5 min; prep time not separately stated but included conservatively
Parsley quantity conservatively classified as present but not affecting allergen/diet flags
No wheat, gluten-containing grains, or barley/rye present; gluten-free classification holds
Eggs explicitly listed and used as primary ingredient
No fish, shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, soy, or sesame in listed ingredients
Chorizo treated as pork sausage with no ambiguous compounds
instructions:
step 1
Cook the potato in boiling water for 8-10 mins or until tender. Drain and allow to steam-dry. Heat oil in an omelette pan, add chorizo and cook for 2 mins. Add the potato and cook for a further 5 mins until the potato starts to crisp. Spoon pan contents out, wipe pan and cook a 2 or 3-egg omelette in the same pan. When almost cooked, scatter with the chorizo and potato, parsley and cheese. Fold the omelette in the pan and cook for 1 min more to melt the cheese.
